title: Ours had a faulty seal in the lid.  But the cup is a must have.
text: Ours had a faulty seal in the lid.  But the cup is a must have.. The cup itself is wonderful, but the lid did not work.  I love the color, but we have to use other lids for it because the matching one has a seal that allows too much water or liquid underneath to have a good fit, so the lid doesn't wash well in the dishwasher.  I have several cups that are this designed by Copco, but only this particular one has the faulty lid/seal.  But that's OK we use other lids with it or  use without a lid inside the house .

product_metadata.title: Copco Acadia Double Wall Reusable Insulated Travel to Go Mug with Non-Slip Sleeve, 16 ounces, Translucent Navy
features: Durable, BPA-free plastic construction; double walled insulation keeps drinks hot or cold
Quarter-turn lid sealing design helps prevent leaks and spills
Textured, non-slip sleeve; will fit standard cup holders
description: The Copco Acadia Travel Mug is the perfect choice for enjoying your favorite beverage on-the-go! Copco's Acadia reusable travel cup combines function and sleek design and easily replaces paper and Styrofoam coffee cups. Crafted from durable, BPA free plastic, this travel companion features double-wall insulation that helps keeps drinks hot or cold. The lid has a quarter-turn sealing mechanism which helps prevents against messy spills. A textured, non-slip sleeve not only guards again scalding but adds a fun pop of color. Available in a variety of colors, this travel mug can hold up to 16-ounces. Microwave and dishwasher safe.
